''See also: [[Lowgold Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Lowgold represents the initial stage of [[advancement]] within the [[Gold]] tier of [[sacred artists]]. It is a significant milestone that follows the [[Iron stage]], providing practitioners with a massive increase in power compared to lower ranks. This [[advancement]] is characterized by the presence of a [[Goldsign]]—a visible manifestation of a [[Remnant]], such as a parasite or light pattern on the body—which serves to identify an individual's specific [[Path]]. While Lowgolds are significantly more powerful than [[Jades]], they occupy the lowest rung of the [[Gold]] hierarchy, positioned below [[Highgold]] and [[Truegold]]. The transition from Lowgold to higher tiers is difficult; for instance, only a small fraction of practitioners successfully reach [[Highgold]]. In combat, Lowgolds possess greater speed and enhanced senses, though they remain vastly outmatched by higher-ranking entities like [[Underlord|Underlords]]. They are often utilized in organized groups, such as guards or squad members, to provide protection or support. Despite their relative weakness among the [[Golds]], they are still formidable enough to be considered dangerous by those at lower stages of cultivation.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Lowgold represents the initial rank within the [[Gold stage]] of [[advancement]]. This level of strength sits above the [[Jade stage]] but remains below the status of [[Highgold]]. Those who reach this level of progression encounter [[Remnants]] from a few Lowgolds, though the path is difficult as only one in a thousand individuals successfully advances to [[Highgold]]. Within this hierarchy, Lowgold serves as a specific stage of status associated with [[Lindon]]'s companion.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Lowgold serves as a specific stage or rank within the progression of power. It is recognized as a [[training course]] level that an individual like [[Lindon]] might eventually visit. During her time at this stage, [[Yerin]] demonstrated significant skill and control over her abilities. However, the rank also carries danger, as [[Jai Long]] expressed an intention to kill a Lowgold.}}

== Skysworn ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Lowgold serves as a specific classification within the combat charts and is used as a designation at the [[Skysworn]] fairground. This stage of power is characterized by individuals who can move faster than [[Jade]] and includes a group of gray-skinned people. Among the [[Skysworn]] trainees, those at this level are considered lower-class students. [[Lindon]] achieved this rank in his [[pure core]] by utilizing refined Lowgold and [[Highgold]] cores, making him qualified to apply for the position.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Lowgold represents a specific stage of power that can be consumed by Mu Enkai{{!}}Enkai's fire in mere seconds. During an encounter, a young woman commands the Lowgold to hold its position, and it remains alive. [[Ekeri]] intends to utilize two Lowgold assistants as a means to prevent [[Lindon]] from escaping, marking the stage as an opponent that [[Lindon]] must fight. Additionally, the oracle once occupied this level of power before being raised to [[Truegold]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
